text:
marco: Heads-up 1 we've got a customer story in the works with NimbusGrid. They've agreed to a short video interview + written Q&A next Tuesday 10:00am PT. Main asks: quote clearance, logo permission, and embargo window. Also want to route webinar signups to a dedicated list: 'nimbus-webinar-ops'.

jena: Great. I'll own copy and the blog draft. Can we get an exact quote on cost-savings? If they give a percent, legal will want supporting data. Otherwise we can use language like 'notable reduction in inference costs.'

sam: Ops: I'll book the Zoom and recording kit. Need to confirm whether we can film their product UI. If they're ok, we should get a signed asset release. I'll ping them for a quick asset permission form.

lily: For demand gen, will we run a joint promo? If yes, we need a co-marketing checklist and a shared promo calendar slot (we prefer Tue/Thu for higher signups). Also request: two short quotes for social and one longer for the case study.

marco: Paste of the three candidate lines the customer said in the demo call (verbatim). Please review and flag anything legal might ask for: 
```
"Moving inference to Redwood Dedicated dropped our 95th-percentile request latency from ~320ms to ~190ms during peak."
"Batching + KV cache reduced GPU spend on session flows by nearly 45% in our eval window."
"Launch was frictionless 1 our infra team didn't need to change deployment tooling, which saved an internal release cycle."
```

jena: I'll break those into short soundbite options. For the long quote, I want to stitch the first and third lines into a single paragraph.

sam: Confirming we'll capture separate takes of each line so we have edit flexibility. Also attaching a short consent blurb to the invite.

lily: Routing: sample SFDC webhook payload and queue name below. We'll auto-tag leads with utm_medium=partner and campaign=nimbus-grid-launch.
```
POST /hooks/sfdc HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "source": "nimbus-webinar-ops",
  "email": "{registrant_email}",
  "first_name": "{registrant_first}",
  "last_name": "{registrant_last}",
  "utm_campaign": "nimbus-grid-launch",
  "target_queue": "NimbusGrid Webinar"
}
```

marco: Legal note: they used a percent ("nearly 45%"), so we'll need either a metrics snapshot or we quote a conservative phrasing. Jena, can you prepare the blog with optional appendix that includes raw numbers gated behind a form? That way public marketing can say "up to 45%" with a footnote linking to gated data.

jena: Yep. I'll draft the post with a gated appendix and mark the public claims as conservative. Also will include an author checklist: proofread, legal sign-off, assets uploaded to drive, webhook tested.

sam: ops-bot: Zoom meeting "NimbusGrid case interview" created by sam for 2026-06-09 10:00 PT. Recording enabled.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach release form to calendar event. Link template: https://drive.google.com/fake-link/nimbus-release-template

lily: For the webinar list, do we want to create an onboarding automation that sends an intro email + a calendar save? I can set up a two-email cadence: confirmation + 24h reminder. Also will prep two 20s clips for LinkedIn/Twitter.

marco: Embargo request from customer: earliest publish 2026-06-16 07:00 PT. Courtney from legal isn't on this thread can someone loop legal? We need sign-off by 6/12 EOD to meet that date.

jena: I'll draft the quote package and circulate to legal by EOD tomorrow. If logo usage is restricted, we'll prepare anonymized versions and note that in the playbook.

sam: I'll upload the raw recording + transcript to the case assets folder after the interview. Will flag timestamps for each approved soundbite.

lily: Created placeholder landing page in CMS and added UTM params. Will switch to final copy once jena posts the landing copy.

marco: Solid. Next steps checklist: 1) legal sign-off on quotes & logo (owner: legal), 2) release signed (owner: sam), 3) landing page live + webhook test (owner: lily), 4) blog draft with gated appendix (owner: jena). Ping me when each is done. :white_check_mark:
